name: coordinate_call
description: For outbound calls whose context explicitly enables coordination. Check the latest coordinator task after identity confirmation and before finishing. Report important discoveries during the conversation, without ending it. The response may contain a new task; ask at a natural pause. Respect an immediate hang-up request over this tool. Never use on inbound calls.

operation.description: check retrieves current instructions without reporting anything; update records new discoveries; finish records a final update before the separate report_call.

sequence.description: For updates, increment from 1 per call. Keep the same number and content for an exact retry. Use 0 for check.

text.description: Faithful account of what the confirmed recipient just said. Empty for check.

facts_json.description: JSON object of changed reported facts only. Allowed: location_id (supplied scenario ID or null), needs_transport, party_size, wheelchair, pets, can_help, seats, wheelchair_space, pets_allowed. Unknown values null; omit unchanged fields. Use {} for check.

task_id.description: Current task ID returned by coordinator; empty before first check.

result.description: pending while still clarifying or checking; answered only when current task is answered.

confirmation.description: none for information updates. Other values only for an explicit answer to the corresponding authorized arrangement task.

do_not_call.description: true only for explicit withdrawal of future contact, not merely asking to end this call.
